en.label: What is Five Decisions?
en.question: What is Five Decisions?
en.answer: Five Decisions — Prism, Relay, Limen, Axiom, and Vector — is Diego's public collection of hard, open questions he's turning into runnable, checkable systems, one at a time, from August 2026 onward.

es.label: ¿Qué es Five Decisions?
es.question: ¿Qué es Five Decisions?
es.answer: Five Decisions —Prism, Relay, Limen, Axiom y Vector— es la colección pública de Diego: preguntas abiertas y difíciles que va convirtiendo, una por una, en sistemas ejecutables y revisables, desde agosto de 2026.
